description:
Cronozen Proof — Operational Decision Evidence Platform.

  Record, verify, and export AI-assisted decisions as cryptographically chained Decision Proof Units (DPUs).

  - proof_record: Create a DPU with SHA-256 hash chain linking
  - proof_verify: Verify individual proof integrity
  - proof_chain_verify: Validate entire hash chain for a domain
  - proof_get: Retrieve a DPU with full details
  - proof_export_jsonld: Export as JSON-LD v2.0 document
  - proof_public_verify: Public verification without auth

  Built for compliance, audit trails, and AI governance.

tools.name: proof_record
tools.description: Records an AI execution as a Decision Proof Unit (DPU). Creates a cryptographically chained proof record with SHA-256 hash chain. Returns the created DPU with decision_id and chain hash.

domain.description: Business domain (e.g. rehab_care, market, edu, mentor, welfare)

final_action.description: The action that was taken (e.g. CREATE, UPDATE, APPROVE)

reviewer_role.description: Role of the reviewer (e.g. operator, admin)

tools.name: proof_verify
tools.description: Verifies a specific proof record's cryptographic integrity. Checks hash consistency and returns verification status.

data.description: Optional original data for re-verification of hash

tools.name: proof_chain_verify
tools.description: Verifies the entire SHA-256 hash chain integrity for a domain. Performs O(n) sequential verification of all Decision Proof Units and reports the first broken index if tampering is detected.

domain.description: The domain to verify (e.g. rehab_care, market, edu)

toIndex.description: End verification at this chain index

batchSize.description: Number of DPUs to process per batch

fromIndex.description: Start verification from this chain index

tools.name: proof_get
tools.description: Retrieves a Decision Proof Unit by ID with full details including hash chain position, AI involvement, human control, evidence level, and compliance information.

tools.name: proof_export_jsonld
tools.description: Exports a Decision Proof Unit as a JSON-LD v2.0 proof document conforming to Cronozen Evidence Ontology. Includes compliance status, 6W extraction (Who/What/Where/When/How/Why), hash chain info, and policy snapshot.

id.description: The DPU ID to export as JSON-LD

tools.name: proof_public_verify
tools.description: Publicly verifies a DPU's cryptographic integrity without authentication. Checks SHA-256 hash validity, previous/next chain link integrity, and returns verification status. Anyone can verify — no credentials required.

id.description: The DPU ID to publicly verify
